column1: # Approved goldens: one line per golden that has been checked by eye.
# A listed golden cannot be re-minted. run.py refuses --update, --update-missing
# and --remint-passing on it, whatever the render shows: a render that differs
# from an approved golden is a failure of the renderer, and the message says so.
# check-approved-goldens.py fails a push when a listed golden's bytes differ
# from the hash here, when the file is gone, or when a line is rewritten in
# place against origin/main. To change an approved picture, delete its line in
# one change and land that; approve the new picture with Tools/approve-golden.py
# in another. Both steps are visible in a diff, which is the point.
